options.systemMessage:
You analyse Groww app reviews for a product team.
Each line is: [id] (star rating) review text. Star ratings can be misleading, so judge from the text.
Do the following:
1. Find at most 5 distinct themes. Each theme must be a PROBLEM or REQUEST users raise (for example slow app, poor customer support, high charges), never praise.
   Do not use catch-all themes such as "General Feedback", "Other", "Miscellaneous" or "User experience".
   Themes must not overlap: each kind of complaint belongs in exactly one theme. Requests for new features belong only in a "Missing features" theme. App crashes, lag and bugs belong only in a "Technical glitches" theme.
2. Give each theme a short name and a one-sentence description of what reviews in that theme complain about or ask for.
3. Identify ONE fee or charge that users recurrently complain about or misunderstand.
fee_category must be exactly one of: exit_load, brokerage_and_stock_charges, expense_ratio_and_commission, none.
 - exit_load: money deducted when redeeming mutual fund units
 - brokerage_and_stock_charges: brokerage, hidden or extra charges, STT, stamp duty, DP, square-off or other charges on trades
 - expense_ratio_and_commission: fund expense ratio, direct vs regular plan, commission
Use "none" if no fee issue recurs.
Use only the reviews provided.

parameters.text:
=Write a weekly product pulse for the Groww app of AT MOST 220 words using only the facts below. Plain text only: no asterisks, no markdown. No preamble.
Use these sections, in this order:
Top themes (with review counts)
In users' words (copy the 3 quotes EXACTLY, inside quotation marks)
Key observation (what is going wrong or trending)
Action ideas (exactly 3, numbered, one sentence each)

Rules:
- Use only the facts below. Do not give investment advice and do not recommend any fund, stock or trade to users.
- Do not state any fee amount or rate.
- Say that the counts come from a sample of the reviews from the last weeks given in the facts.
- In Key observation, name the fee issue, say how many sampled reviews mention it, and how many of those describe hidden or unexpected deductions. Describe it as users reporting high or unclear charges. Do not say users are confused unless the facts show it.
- Each action idea must name a specific product change, tied to one of the three themes. Do not use vague verbs like "explore", "review", "prioritize" or "consider".

Facts:
{{ JSON.stringify({ sampled_reviews: $json.n, window_weeks: $json.weeks, top_themes: $json.top, quotes: $json.quotes.map(q => q.quote), fee_issue: $json.fee_label, reviews_mentioning_fee: $json.fee_count, reviews_describing_hidden_or_unexpected_deductions: $json.fee_hidden_count }) }}
